paidAccountMylist.note: Shared paid (plan 2) key, two GET /torrents/mylist?limit=1 then /user/me: mylist and user/me count separately.

source: api.torbox.app, measured 2026-11-02. A 200-call burst at 50 concurrent on /user/me: 99 x 200 then 101 x 429, Retry-After 50..61 s, while /torrents/checkcached on the same key still answered 200 with its own fresh budget. The 429 sends no Access-Control-Expose-Headers, so a browser sees none of these headers: Retry-After and x-ratelimit-* are not CORS-safelisted.
